objects.name: Analytic 1788
objects.description: For Android, detect File and Directory Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Access via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: opendir() or File.listFiles() on path IN $ExternalStoragePaths$ called > $FileEnumThreshold$ times within $EnumWindow$ by app NOT IN $FileEnumAllowList$]; Network Traffic Flow via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
